mcat_description.short: MS Structure Services covers end-to-end mild steel structural fabrication and erection services — designing, cutting, welding, and installing steel frameworks for industrial sheds, mezzanine floors, warehouses, canopies, and platforms as per client drawings and IS standards.
mcat_description.long: MS Structure Services refers to turnkey mild steel structural fabrication and erection contracts where a service provider designs, fabricates, and installs load-bearing steel frameworks using IS:2062 E250/E350 grade hot-rolled sections — angles, channels, beams, columns, trusses, and purlins. The service spans the full project lifecycle: structural design and drawing, shop fabrication (cutting, bending, welding, bolting), surface treatment (primer/paint/galvanising), and on-site erection with alignment and load testing. Primary applications include industrial factory sheds, warehouse structures, mezzanine floors, canopies, staircase structures, pipe racks, and equipment support platforms. Compliance with IS:800 (Code of Practice for General Construction in Steel) governs structural design, while IS:2062 defines the material grade standard for the steel sections used.

market_context: MS Structure Services in India refers to the end-to-end mild steel structural fabrication and erection market, where contractors design, fabricate, and install steel frameworks using IS:2062 E250/E350 grade hot-rolled sections governed by IS:800 structural design code. The market spans industrial sheds, warehouse structures, mezzanine floors, canopies, staircases, pipe racks, and equipment support platforms, with service providers offering turnkey solutions from design to on-site erection. Key buyer industries include manufacturing plants, warehouses and logistics, oil and gas, power plants, pharmaceutical facilities, and commercial construction. Fabrication processes involve cutting, bending, welding (MIG/TIG/arc), bolting, and surface treatment (primer painting, hot-dip galvanising); quality assurance includes NDT weld testing, alignment checks, and load testing per IS and ASTM standards. The Indian market distinguishes between light structure fabrication (canopies, staircases, gates) and heavy structural fabrication (industrial sheds, portal frames, gantries), with PEB (Pre-Engineered Building) erection services forming a growing sub-segment. Buyers typically quote requirements by span, bay size, height, load capacity, and steel grade; sellers respond with fabrication drawings and weight-based or area-based quotations.
